name: cobuilder-implement
title: CoBuilder Implement — a design becomes verified code
outcome: The architecture design produced by cobuilder-architect carries directly into implementation: its intent is decomposed into testable epics, and each epic ships as vertical slices that an independent validator scores at 0.90 or better before the next one starts.
done_when: the skill runs G1 through G4 and stops at each gate for approval
a slice is scored at 0.90 or better by a validator that executes the tests and never wrote the code
an epic below 0.90 loops back to GREEN and closes
cobuilder-implement builds one real change end to end under its own gates
abort_if: 0.90 proves unreachable in practice, so most real slices escalate rather than pass, which makes the threshold theatre

min_work.derived_from: 6 districts (skills, scripts, commands, viewer, docs, .cobuilder-architect), 3 related ADRs, 1 boundary rule on install surface

epics.note: Shares a branch and a pull request with the design-mode design. See ADR-0013: a branch may carry more than one design.

Gate 4b is enforced instead of merely specified. The per-epic technical solution design already exists in SKILL.md section 4b, with a six-section template, and five downstream files reference the artifact. Nothing checks that it was written. Checked on 2026-08-24: zero epic-<id>-design.md files exist, and six epics shipped without one. Four failures allow that. Gate 4's only exit check counts rubrics, so a Gate 4 that skips 4b still passes. slice-loop.js builds the epic-design path and never checks the file exists, so the red and green agents are told to read a file that is absent and quietly fall back to 03-program-design.md. rubric-authoring.md tells the author to update the technical design first, and nobody checks that either. No test asserts the artifact. The root cause is that 4b is the only Gate 4 sub-step whose output nothing downstream mechanically requires: the loop cannot score without rubrics or iterate without a slice plan, but it can read an absent design. This epic adds the exit check, the existence guard in the workflow, a test, and sub-step tracking in 00-status.md so an approved Gate 4 cannot hide a missing 4b. Raised 2026-08-22, re-scoped 2026-08-24 from 'write the process' to 'enforce the process' after reading the skill.
